description: Implementation of an immutable ResultList class in Java that manages a list of items, paging information, and optional sort values. It provides read-only access to its internal list with standard collection methods and is annotated for nullability.

classes.name: ResultListImpl
classes.description: A final, immutable class implementing the ResultList interface, wrapping a list of items with pagination and optional last sort values.

methods.name: ResultListImpl
methods.description: Constructs a ResultListImpl with given items and next page offset.

methods.name: ResultListImpl
methods.description: Constructs a ResultListImpl with items, next page offset, and last result sort values.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified index in the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the list contains a specific object.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the items.

methods.description: Returns an array containing all items.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all items, using provided array if large enough.
